notes: Read all 232 line-numbered source lines before editing; every line was considered. Imports (L1-8): the react hooks useState/useRef/useEffect are kept; the DOM 'type KeyboardEvent' (L1) is dropped and replaced by RN's NativeSyntheticEvent<TextInputKeyPressEventData>. react-i18next useTranslation (L2) becomes a native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback returning t(key, default, params?) that interpolates i18next-style {{count}} placeholders (every translation key + intent preserved). lucide-react MessageSquare/Plus/Trash2 (L3) become decorative AppText glyphs (MESSAGE_GLYPH 💬, PLUS_GLYPH +, TRASH_GLYPH 🗑). '@/components/ui' Button/ConfirmDialog/GlassPanel/Input (L4): GlassPanel uses the existing native primitive ('../../../../../components/ui/GlassPanel'); ConfirmDialog imports the already-ported native '../../../../components/ui/ConfirmDialog'; Button + Input are reproduced as local native-safe Pressable / TextInput equivalents (the AlertMessageEditor/VehicleMultiSelect reproduce-locally precedent). '@/components/feedback' EmptyState (L5) is reproduced inline (the native EmptyState requires title+message, while the web call passes only message+icon — an inline glyph+message block matches the source exactly). '@/lib/cn' (L6) is dropped for StyleSheet + tokens. '@/lib/dateFormat' formatRelative (L7) is ported verbatim as a local function. The ChatSessionInfo type (L8) imports from the native '../../../../api/types' (interface verified identical: id/title/first_message/message_count/last_message_at/created_at).

SessionListProps interface (L10-19) ported 1:1: sessions, activeSessionId, onSelect, onNewChat, onRename, onDelete, isLoading?, className?. className keeps its slot for source compatibility but is ignored on native (Tailwind class strings are meaningless under StyleSheet) and is documented inline + not destructured to avoid an unused var. The component JSDoc (L21-30) is ported and adapted — 'Double-click a row title' is rewritten as 'Long-press a row title' (the native rename affordance), the other four behavior bullets (New chat always visible, active highlighted surface, ConfirmDialog before delete, empty state) are preserved verbatim.

Component signature + destructure (L31-40) preserved exactly. useTranslation() (L41) -> useNativeTranslationFallback(). State (L42-45): renamingId/setRenamingId, renameDraft/setRenameDraft, pendingDelete/setPendingDelete preserved with identical names + types; renameInputRef (L45) changes from RefObject<HTMLInputElement> to useRef<TextInput>(null). The focus effect (L47-52) is ported: renameInputRef.current.focus() is kept; the web .select() (no RN equivalent) maps to the TextInput selectTextOnFocus prop. startRename (L54-57), commitRename (L59-66, trim + guard + onRename + close), cancelRename (L68-71) ported verbatim.

handleRenameKeyDown (L73-81): the web onKeyDown switch (Enter -> preventDefault + commitRename; Escape -> preventDefault + cancelRename) is ported to onKeyPress(NativeSyntheticEvent<TextInputKeyPressEventData>) reading e.nativeEvent.key; preventDefault is unavailable on native onKeyPress and is omitted. The TextInput also wires onSubmitEditing -> commitRename (the canonical soft-keyboard Enter) and onBlur -> commitRename (faithful to the web onBlur=commitRename on L134); commitRename's renamingId guard makes the blur-after-commit path a no-op exactly as on web. Escape only fires on hardware keyboards — documented unavailable on touch.

Render root (L83-84 fragment) preserved as a fragment wrapping the GlassPanel + ConfirmDialog. GlassPanel (L85, w-72 shrink-0 overflow-hidden flex flex-col + className) -> native GlassPanel with styles.panel (width 288, flexShrink 0, overflow hidden); the column flex + className override are layout concerns handled by tokens. Header (L86-96): the p-3 border-b div -> styles.header (padding 12, borderBottomWidth 1, border token); the web Button (variant primary, size sm, full width, Plus icon, onNewChat, 'New Chat') -> a local Pressable (accent background, PLUS_GLYPH + label, testID session-list-new-chat, accessibilityRole button) firing onNewChat. The 'Sessions' label (L98-100, text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-secondary) -> styles.sectionLabel AppText.

List container (L102, flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1) -> a ScrollView (styles.list flexGrow/flexShrink, contentContainerStyle padding 8 + gap 4, keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'). Loading branch (L103-106): isLoading && sessions.length===0 -> the 'Loading…' AppText (testID session-list-loading, tone muted, centered). Empty branch (L107-112): the web EmptyState (MessageSquare icon, 'No conversations yet', py-8) -> an inline View (testID session-list-empty, paddingVertical 32) with a decorative MESSAGE_GLYPH AppText + the muted message; the EmptyState no-action comment intent is preserved (transient empty state, no recovery action).

sessions.map (L113-191): per-row isActive/isRenaming derivation (L115-116) preserved. The row wrapper div (L118-126, rounded-lg border, active bg-[--surface-2]+purple-500/30 border, inactive transparent+hover surface-1) -> a View (testID session-list-row-{id}) with styles.row + styles.rowActive (surfaceRaised bg + violetBorder) / styles.rowInactive (transparent border). Renaming branch (L127-138): the p-2 flex div + Input (ref, value, onChange, onKeyDown, onBlur, size sm, aria-label) -> styles.renameWrap View + a TextInput (ref=renameInputRef, value=renameDraft, onChangeText=setRenameDraft, onKeyPress=handleRenameKeyDown, onSubmitEditing+onBlur=commitRename, autoFocus, selectTextOnFocus, accessibilityLabel from t('chatbot.aria.renameSession'), testID session-list-rename-input).

Select button (L139-169): the web <button> (onClick=onSelect, onDoubleClick=startRename, focus ring, aria-current, title 'Double-click to rename') -> a Pressable (testID session-list-select-{id}, onPress=onSelect(session.id), onLongPress=startRename(session), accessibilityRole button, accessibilityState={selected:isActive}, accessibilityHint from t('chatbot.aria.doubleClickRename')). Title span (L151-158, text-xs font-medium truncate, active text-purple-200 else text-primary) -> AppText numberOfLines={1} fontWeight 500 with titleActive(colors.violet)/titleInactive(colors.textPrimary). Subtitle span (L159-167, text-[10px] text-muted truncate) -> AppText numberOfLines={1} fontSize 10 tone muted: last_message_at ? formatRelative(last_message_at) : t('chatbot.session.empty','Empty'), then ' · ', then t('chatbot.session.messageCount','{{count}} msgs',{count: session.message_count}) — the count interpolation preserved by the native t fallback.

Delete button (L171-188): rendered only when !isRenaming; the web absolute top-right <button> (onClick stopPropagation + setPendingDelete, opacity-on-hover, hover rose, focus ring, aria-label, Trash2 icon) -> a Pressable (testID session-list-delete-{id}, position absolute top/right 6, hitSlop 6, onPress=setPendingDelete(session), accessibilityLabel from t('chatbot.aria.deleteSession'), pressed -> dangerSurface tint) wrapping a decorative TRASH_GLYPH AppText. stopPropagation is unnecessary on native because the delete Pressable is a sibling overlay, not nested inside the select Pressable, so a press never reaches the row.

ConfirmDialog (L196-213) wired 1:1 to the native port: open={!!pendingDelete}, title=t('chatbot.delete.title','Delete conversation?'), message=t('chatbot.delete.message', 'This will permanently remove this conversation and all its messages.'), confirmLabel=t('chatbot.delete.confirm','Delete'), cancelLabel=t('common.cancel','Cancel'), variant='danger', onConfirm fires onDelete(pendingDelete.id)+clears pendingDelete (guarded by the pendingDelete null check from L207), onCancel clears pendingDelete. displayTitle helper (L218-232) ported verbatim: title override (trim) -> first_message (trim, >60 chars truncated to slice(0,60)+'…') -> t('chatbot.session.untitled','Untitled conversation'); the t param type is kept as (key, defaultValue) => string, to which the 3-arg native t is assignable.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only React, react-native primitives (Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View + NativeSyntheticEvent/TextInputKeyPressEventData types), the existing native AppText/GlassPanel, theme tokens (colors/spacing/typography), the native-ported ConfirmDialog, and the native ChatSessionInfo type. Behavior verified by __tests__/SessionList.test.tsx (9 tests): renders panel + new-chat (fires onNewChat); loading line only while loading+empty; empty state; display-title resolution (override/truncated-first-message/untitled) + '3 msgs'/'Empty' meta; onSelect on row press; long-press opens the rename editor and saves the trimmed title (closes after); blank draft does not call onRename; Escape cancels without saving; delete opens the ConfirmDialog and confirm fires onDelete. Gates: npm run typecheck PASS, npm run lint -- --quiet PASS, npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles PASS. Source line range L1-L232 fully covered.
